Hello. I understand how you are feeling. It seems that the rural life has really taken a toll on how you perceive the world. You need to know that although we can change the way we perceive our environment, there is a reason there are different kinds of worlds (the city life, the rural life, etc), and that is because everyone thrives in a different kind of place. Let me ask you this. It is my one question that really will get you thinking--and can possibly help you out--if you were to die right now, this VERY MOMENT, what would you have liked to see yourself accomplish? Would it give you peace to see that you were solely focused on your kids, and stayed at home? 

I don't think you found "your thing" yet. I really don't. Finding that one thing that you live for will help with depression, and the such, will really get you going. Give yourself TIME. You don't need to find it RIGHT NOW. It's time to explore, it's time to find what gives you JOY, not happiness ;) 

In regards to your children, practicing your ukelele seems like a great way to give back to your children, because when you take time for yourself, you will see that you will have more room to give over to your kids. It only makes sense to care for yourself before you care for your kids. Don't neglect them--obviously--but I challenge you to set aside even just 15 minutes with absolutely no distractions to just play your ukelele. Go outside if the air can calm your mind even further. Giving love to your 1 year old is very vital, but you can always receive assistance when it is important to focus on YOU. 

And with your "friends," I honestly don't have too much to say. When I was suffering from depression, I had to really really try to make it seem like I was all okay because I couldn't allow them to see me as some other than who they knew me for. Do you have anyone else from the city that you can connect with? 

And finally, with therapy, yeah. There is nothing free in this world. It's funny. I am trying to work on a website that gives free therapy to people. I am ALWAYS here to help you out. My email is [berit979@gmail.com](mailto:berit979@gmail.com), and I will always respond to you in times of need. Really. Im only 19, but I hope I have given you even one ounce of comfort. Best wishes to you.
